name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE
context: Title of the settings section which controls the material of the browser surface.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_STYLE
context: Accessibility label for the picker that controls the material of the browser surface.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_SOLID
context: Solid option in the surface material picker.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_TRANSPARENT
context: Transparent option in the surface material picker.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_LIQUID_GLASS
context: Liquid Glass option in the surface material picker.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_BLUR
context: Blur option in the surface material picker.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_FROSTED_GLASS
context: Frosted Glass option in the surface material picker.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_SOLID_DESCRIPTION
context: Description of the Solid surface material.
message: The browser surface is filled with the theme color.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_TRANSPARENT_DESCRIPTION
context: Description of the Transparent surface material.
message: The desktop shows through the browser surface without any blur.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_LIQUID_GLASS_DESCRIPTION
context: Description of the Liquid Glass surface material.
message: The system Liquid Glass material that bends and reflects what is behind the window. Earlier versions of macOS use a similar glass effect.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_BLUR_DESCRIPTION
context: Description of the Blur surface material.
message: The desktop shows through the browser surface with an adjustable blur.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_FROSTED_GLASS_DESCRIPTION
context: Description of the Frosted Glass surface material.
message: A milky, softly grained glass that diffuses what is behind the window.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_OPACITY
context: Label for the slider that controls the opacity of the browser surface.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_TINT
context: Label for the slider that controls how strongly the theme color tints the browser surface.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_HIGHLIGHT
context: Label for the slider that controls the strength of the light reflection on the glass surface.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_VARIANT
context: Label for the menu that selects the Liquid Glass variant.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_VARIANT_REGULAR
context: Regular option in the Liquid Glass variant menu.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_VARIANT_CLEAR
context: Clear option in the Liquid Glass variant menu.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_BLUR_RADIUS
context: Label for the slider that controls the blur strength of the browser surface.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_FROST
context: Label for the slider that controls how milky the frosted glass surface is.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_GRAIN
context: Label for the slider that controls the amount of grain on the frosted glass surface.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIOX_SURFACE_RESET
context: Label for the button that resets the options of the selected surface material.
